arStrings.szText: "Ivo is in Lycander, just as you hoped. He's asked me to bring you to him."
It’s true, then. He’s here, and he remembers me...I wasn't sure he would.
The day we got our marching orders, we patrolled past some of those damned “pilgrims of Akarat” in Kyovashad. They stood around a man who was practically on death's door.
They claimed their prophet would "heal" this ailing pilgrim, that through Akarat’s power he would live on. I ignored their foolish prattle, but Ivo was...captivated.
He was never one to fall for the fanatical ravings of blasphemers. But something happened to him that day. And by the next full moon, he was gone.
The rest of our regiment said I should let him go, but I can’t. How could my brother become a heretic? (sighs) Lead me to him, friend.
